lockscreens.name: Terminal
lockscreens.author: root-sec
lockscreens.summary: A phosphor CRT console lock for Ryoku.
lockscreens.description: A full-screen terminal lock: phosphor-on-black console type, a live status readout (uptime, load, memory, temperature, media, keymap) and a CRT post-effect. Password entry happens in the hidden field the qylock engine owns.
